name: Anja Korhonen
bio:
Anja's motorsport journey began in her teens, tinkering with engines in her father's garage in rural Finland. This hands-on experience ignited a passion that led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, she spent several years working for a small rally team, honing her skills in data analysis and problem-solving. Her meticulous approach and ability to translate complex technical information into actionable insights quickly earned her a reputation as a highly competent engineer.

Driven by a desire to work at the cutting edge of motorsport, Anja joined Caterham Academy. She thrives on the pressure of race weekends, meticulously analyzing telemetry and collaborating with the driver to optimize car setup. Anja's strength lies in her ability to balance technical expertise with a pragmatic approach, ensuring that every decision is data-driven and focused on maximizing performance. She is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her unwavering commitment to achieving the best possible results for her team.

physical.hairStyle: Straight, shoulder-length hair, usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Anja is of average height with a focused expression, often seen with grease under her fingernails despite her best efforts.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations during races.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Finnish coffee readily available in the garage.
